name: Bailian Decisions
description: Aliyun Bailian (Model Studio) System One decision provider: typed choice / score / boolean judgments through decision-model-preview.

keyFile.description: Path to a file holding the Bailian API key (0600). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/.secrets/dashscope-decision.key.

apiKey.description: Inline Bailian API key. Prefer keyFile; this value lives in config and is stored in plaintext unless supplied as a SecretRef.

endpoint.description: System One endpoint host. Default trial.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com; use <WorkspaceId>.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com for production.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (host caps the effective deadline at 30000). Default 20000.
